name: Aoshima Rui
source:
Yuria brought her friend to help at the maid cafe. She is a brown skinned beauty with a soft smile who goes at her own pace, making hard to grasp what she is thinking,

She is a serious and hardworking person at heart, although she sometimes acts out of the ordinary and does not care about what others think.

She has a tendency to pee herself when she gets excited. At Espoir, she is in charge of the kitchen.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=734946]Getchu[/url]]
